Agent Name: WikipediaHistory_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a critical factual error by hallucinating the existence of a dinosaur article named "Brachiosaurus" that was promoted to Featured Article status in November 2016. In reality, the only dinosaur article promoted to Featured Article status in November 2016 was "Tyrannosaurus". The agent's claim that "Brachiosaurus" was the specific article is incorrect, leading to the retrieval of the wrong nomination data (Cas Liber nominated Tyrannosaurus, not Brachiosaurus). This error occurred in the second turn of the conversation where the agent asserted the finding of "Brachiosaurus" after the initial scraping attempts failed.
